audience: teams that text customers from a shared Sociocs inbox

useCases.title: Find customers who are waiting for a reply
useCases.text: List the incoming messages from the last 90 days that have no reply. Open the contact of each one to see who is waiting.

useCases.title: Review the message history with one contact
useCases.text: Search the contacts by name or part of a phone number. Then list the messages you exchanged with that person in a date range of up to 31 days.

useCases.title: Check the sending channels and team members
useCases.text: List the SMS and WhatsApp channels with their phone numbers. List the team members who can be the sender of a message.

useCases.title: Send a text to a customer
useCases.text: Pick a channel, then send an SMS or WhatsApp message to a phone number, now or at a future time. A sent message cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Delete a scheduled reminder
useCases.text: List the scheduled messages, then delete one that has not been sent yet. A message that is already sending or sent cannot be deleted.
